summary: Comprehensive mobile responsiveness testing completed for Devotio Rewards Scanner App on iPhone SE viewport (375x667). All key features verified: mobile-responsive layouts on all pages, currency selector with 14 Latin American currencies, currency persistence after page reload, DEMO cards working correctly, customer name VISIBLE while email/phone MASKED, confirmation modal displays correctly on mobile.
passed_tests: Login page mobile layout (375x667) - Logo fits within viewport, form elements properly sized
Scanner page mobile layout - Scanner viewport fits within mobile width (343x257px), scan button visible
Result page mobile layout - All card types display correctly with proper spacing
Settings page mobile layout - All settings visible, currency selector accessible
Currency selector shows all 14 currencies: CRC, USD, EUR, MXN, COP, PEN, ARS, CLP, GTQ, HNL, NIO, PAB, DOP, BRL
Currency dropdown is scrollable on mobile to access all currencies
Currency selection persists after page reload (tested EUR and BRL)
Currency symbol updates in result page purchase amount input (tested EUR: €, BRL: R$)
Confirmation modal displays correctly on mobile with mandatory comment field (*)
DEMO-001 (stamp_card): Maria González - stamp grid visible, 8/10 stamps
DEMO-002 (cashback_card): Carlos Rodriguez - 5% cashback rate, purchase amount input visible
DEMO-003 (discount_card): Ana Martinez - 1% discount level, purchase amount input visible
DEMO-005 (coupon): Sofia Lopez - USAR tab for single-use coupon
DEMO-006 (multipass): Miguel Santos - AGREGAR/CANJEAR/PUNTOS tabs visible
Customer name VISIBLE (not masked) on result page
Email/phone MASKED (***@***.*** and ***-***-****) in customer info section
Spanish language throughout all pages (Iniciar Sesión, Escanear, Configuración, etc.)
seed_data_creation: Using existing demo cards DEMO-001 through DEMO-007
context_for_next_testing_agent: All mobile responsiveness features verified working correctly on iPhone SE viewport (375x667). Currency selector with 14 Latin American currencies works correctly with persistence. All DEMO cards (DEMO-001 through DEMO-007) work correctly with different card types. Spanish language is primary throughout the app. Customer names are visible (not masked) while email/phone are properly masked. Confirmation modal has mandatory comment field with asterisk.
mocked_api_note: DEMO cards (DEMO-001 through DEMO-007) use MOCK data even with Boomerang API key configured. This is intentional for demo/proposal purposes.
